en: A black-and-white historical postcard showing a wide cobblestone street lined with low colonial-style buildings. People, including adults and children, walk or stand along the street. Low hills or mountains rise in the background. On the right is a long, walled military-type building with an arched entrance. Printed caption text appears at the bottom center of the image.
